name: Buzz Cut
shortLine: Very short, same length all over. Clean and easy.
description: One short length all over, cut with the machine. Clean, cool and no fuss.
pickIf: you want zero styling and a cool, clean head.
skipIf: you have a round or long face, or don't want your head shape to show.

faq.q: What machine number is a buzz cut?
faq.a: Usually #2 (6 mm). Ask for #1 if you want it shorter, or #3 for a softer look.

faq.q: Is a buzz cut good for hot weather?
faq.a: Yes. With so little hair, your head stays cooler and dries in minutes.

faq.q: Will a buzz cut show scars or bumps on my head?
faq.a: At #1 or #2 they can show. Choose #3 or #4 for more cover.

faq.q: How fast does a buzz cut grow out?
faq.a: Hair grows about 1.25 cm a month, so a #2 buzz looks like a short crew cut after about a month.

barberNote: Customer may ask for #1 or #3 instead.

name: Crew Cut
shortLine: Short sides, a little longer on top. Neat and simple.
description: Short sides with a little more length on top. Neat at work, college or a family function.
pickIf: you want a safe, tidy cut that looks fine everywhere.
skipIf: you have a very long face.
daily: 1 min: push the top forward or up with your hand.
suitsText: Oval, square and round face · All hair types · Thin hair OK

callouts.title: Smooth blend
callouts.text: No line between top and sides.

faq.q: What is the difference between a crew cut and a buzz cut?
faq.a: A buzz cut is one length all over. A crew cut keeps the top a little longer than the sides.

faq.q: What number is a crew cut?
faq.a: Usually machine #2 on the sides and about 1 finger (2 cm) on top, cut with scissors.

faq.q: Is a crew cut good for office?
faq.a: Yes. It's one of the safest cuts for any office, school or family event.

faq.q: Can I get a crew cut with curly hair?
faq.a: Yes. The short length keeps curls neat and easy.

barberSteps: Front of top: a little longer.

shortLine: A longer crew cut. Top can be combed to the side.
description: A longer crew cut with enough top to comb into a side part. Smart but still easy.
pickIf: you want an office-ready look that is still short.
skipIf: you have a round face.
daily: 2 min: comb to the side with a little cream or wax.
suitsText: Oval, square, long and heart face · Straight or wavy hair · Thin hair OK

faq.q: What is the difference between a crew cut and an Ivy League?
faq.a: An Ivy League keeps the top longer, about 2 fingers, so it can be combed into a side part.

faq.q: Is the Ivy League good for thin hair?
faq.a: Yes. The short sides make the top look fuller.

faq.q: Can I wear an Ivy League without a part?
faq.a: Yes. Push it forward or up with your fingers for a relaxed look.

faq.q: How do I keep the side part neat?
faq.a: Comb it while your hair is still a little damp, then add a little cream.

barberSteps: Sides and back: machine #2, blend to #3.
Front: a little longer than back.
Ask: part on left or right?

name: Caesar Cut
shortLine: Short all over with a short straight fringe in front.
description: Short all over, with a short straight fringe combed forward.
pickIf: you want to cover a high forehead or thin hair at the front.
skipIf: you have a round face.
daily: 1 min: comb forward. No product needed.
suitsText: Oval, square, long and heart face · All hair types · Thin hair OK

faq.q: Does a Caesar cut hide a receding hairline?
faq.a: Yes. The short fringe sits over the front and covers a high or thin hairline.

faq.q: How is a Caesar cut different from a French crop?
faq.a: A Caesar has a straight, flat fringe. A French crop has a rougher top.

faq.q: Is a Caesar cut good for curly hair?
faq.a: Yes. Short curls lie forward easily and need no styling.

faq.q: Do I need product for a Caesar cut?
faq.a: No. Just comb it forward. A little wax is optional.

name: French Crop

description: Short sides and a rough top pushed forward into a short fringe. Modern and easy.
pickIf: you want a modern look with almost no work, or to hide a thin front.
skipIf: you have a round face.

suitsText: Oval, square, long and heart face · All hair types · Thin hair OK

faq.q: Is a French crop good for a receding hairline?
faq.a: Yes. The fringe pushed forward covers the front.

faq.q: What product is best for a French crop?
faq.a: Dry wax (clay), for a matte, slightly messy finish.

faq.q: What is the difference between a French crop and a crop fade?
faq.a: The top is the same, but on a crop fade the sides go down to skin.

faq.q: Can I get a French crop with wavy hair?
faq.a: Yes. Waves add natural movement to the top.

pickIf: you want the safest choice for any face, age or job.
skipIf: you want a bold, fashion look.
daily: 2 min: comb with a little cream.
suitsText: All face shapes · All hair types · Thin hair OK

faq.q: What is the difference between a taper and a fade?
faq.a: A taper gets shorter but stops before skin. A fade goes down to bare skin.

faq.q: Is a taper cut good for office?
faq.a: Yes. It's the most office-safe cut in the catalogue.

faq.q: How long does a taper last?
faq.a: It still looks neat after 3–4 weeks, because it grows out gently.

faq.q: Does a taper suit older men?
faq.a: Yes. It suits every age, face shape and hair type.

faq.q: How is a low fade different from a mid fade?
faq.a: A low fade starts just above the ear. A mid fade starts higher, at the temple.

faq.q: Is a low fade OK for school or office?
faq.a: Usually yes. It's the most subtle fade.

faq.q: What numbers are used for a low fade?
faq.a: Usually #0 at the bottom, blended up through #1 to #2.

faq.q: How often does a low fade need a touch-up?
faq.a: Every 2–3 weeks to keep the fade clean.

barberSteps: Fade line: 1 finger above the ear.

faq.q: Where does a mid fade start?
faq.a: Halfway up the side of the head, around the temple.

faq.q: Is a mid fade good for a round face?
faq.a: Yes. Shorter sides with some height on top make the face look longer.

faq.q: What top goes best with a mid fade?
faq.a: A top of 2–3 fingers, pushed up or to the side.

faq.q: How long does a mid fade stay sharp?
faq.a: About 2–3 weeks.

barberSteps: Fade line: middle of the side, at the temple.

callouts.title: High skin fade

faq.q: Is a skin fade the same as a bald fade?
faq.a: Yes. Both take the sides down to bare skin with a razor or shaver.

faq.q: How long does a skin fade stay sharp?
faq.a: About 1–2 weeks. Book a touch-up every 2 weeks.

faq.q: Will a skin fade irritate my skin?
faq.a: It shouldn't. Tell the barber if your skin is sensitive, so they shave gently.

faq.q: Is a skin fade OK for office?
faq.a: It depends on the office. A low fade or taper fade is the safer choice.

faq.q: Which side should my part be on?
faq.a: Usually where your hair already splits naturally. The barber can check.

faq.q: Is a side part good for job interviews?
faq.a: Yes. It's one of the smartest, most classic looks.

faq.q: Pomade or cream for a side part?
faq.a: Shiny wax (pomade) for a polished look, cream for a softer, natural look.

faq.q: Can I get a side part with curly hair?
faq.a: It's hard to keep neat. A Taper Cut or Curly Top Fade works better.

faq.q: Is a comb over fade the same as an old-style comb over?
faq.a: No. It's a modern side part with faded sides, not hair combed over a thin patch.

faq.q: How is it different from a classic side part?
faq.a: A comb over fade has faded sides. A classic side part has longer, tapered sides.

faq.q: Should I get a shaved part line?
faq.a: Only if you want a sharper look. It grows out in about 2 weeks.

faq.q: What product holds a comb over fade?
faq.a: Shiny wax (pomade) or a medium-hold cream.

Part line: above the outer eyebrow.

faq.q: What is the difference between an undercut and a fade?
faq.a: An undercut has one short length on the sides with a clear line. A fade blends from short to long with no line.

faq.q: How long should the top be for an undercut?
faq.a: At least 4 fingers (about 8 cm).

faq.q: Can I hide an undercut at work?
faq.a: Yes. Let the long top fall over the sides.

faq.q: How often do the sides need cutting?
faq.a: Every 3 weeks, before the line softens.

barberSteps: Line: at the top corner of the head.
Do not cut the top short.

faq.q: Pomade or gel for a slick back?
faq.a: Shiny wax (pomade) for a classic shine, gel for a stronger, wet look.

faq.q: How long does hair need to be for a slick back?
faq.a: About 4–5 fingers (8–10 cm) on top.

faq.q: Is a slick back good for thin hair?
faq.a: No. Combing it back separates the hair and shows the scalp.

faq.q: Will it stay back all day?
faq.a: Yes, if you style it while slightly damp and use enough product.

suitsText: Oval, square, round and heart face · Straight or wavy hair

faq.q: What is the difference between a quiff and a pompadour?
faq.a: A quiff lifts mainly the front. A pompadour has more height across the whole top.

faq.q: Do I need a blow dryer for a quiff?
faq.a: Yes, for height that lasts. Blow dry the front up and back.

faq.q: What product holds a quiff?
faq.a: Wax, or dry wax (clay) for a more natural finish.

faq.q: Is a quiff good for a round face?
faq.a: Yes. Height on top makes a round face look longer.

barberSteps: Blow dry front up and back.

name: Pompadour

description: Big height on top, swept up and back. Bold and classic.
pickIf: you want to stand out at a wedding or party.
skipIf: you have a long face or thin hair, or want a quick morning.

suitsText: Oval, square and round face · Straight or wavy hair

faq.q: How long should hair be for a pompadour?
faq.a: About 5 fingers (10 cm) at the front.

faq.q: How do I keep a pompadour up all day?
faq.a: Blow dry it up and back, then shape it with shiny wax (pomade) and a comb.

faq.q: Is a pompadour too much for office?
faq.a: It can be. Ask for a smaller version, or choose a Quiff.

faq.q: Does a pompadour suit a long face?
faq.a: No. The height makes a long face look even longer.

barberSteps: Blow dry top up and back.

faq.q: What is the best product for spiky hair?
faq.a: Strong gel or strong wax.

faq.q: Does spiky hair work with curly hair?
faq.a: Not well. Curls won't stand up in spikes. Try a Curly Top Fade.

faq.q: How long should the top be for spikes?
faq.a: 1–2 fingers (2–4 cm).

faq.q: Will daily gel damage my hair?
faq.a: Not if you wash it out at the end of each day.

barberSteps: Apply gel. Pull hair up in spikes.

faq.q: What is the difference between a faux hawk and a mohawk?
faq.a: A faux hawk keeps the sides short but not shaved. A mohawk takes the sides very short or bare.

faq.q: Can I wear a faux hawk to work?
faq.a: Yes. Comb the top flat and it looks like a normal short cut.

faq.q: What product holds a faux hawk?
faq.a: Wax or gel, pushed up toward the middle.

faq.q: Does a faux hawk suit a round face?
faq.a: Yes. The height makes the face look longer.

barberSteps: Push middle hair up to a point.

faq.q: What does "two-block" mean?
faq.a: The hair is cut in two blocks: short sides underneath, and longer top hair that falls over them.

faq.q: Is a two-block the same as an undercut?
faq.a: It's similar, but the soft top falls over the sides, so no line shows.

faq.q: Does a two-block work with thick hair?
faq.a: Yes. Thick, straight hair is ideal. The barber thins out the top so it sits flat.

faq.q: How do I style a two-block?
faq.a: Blow dry the fringe forward and down, then add a little light wax.

faq.a: About 5–6 fingers on top, with the front reaching eye level.

faq.q: Is a middle part the same as curtain hair?
faq.a: Yes. Curtain hair is another name for it.

faq.q: How do I stop my middle part going flat?
faq.a: Blow dry the roots up and out to each side, then add a little cream.

faq.q: Does a middle part suit a round face?
faq.a: Not really. It adds width at the sides.

faq.q: How long does it take to grow a medium flow?
faq.a: About 6–9 months from a short cut, since hair grows about 1.25 cm a month.

faq.q: How do I get through the awkward growing stage?
faq.a: Keep the sides and back trimmed every 6–8 weeks while the top grows.

faq.q: Is a medium flow OK for office?
faq.a: Yes, if it's clean and pushed back.

faq.q: Does a flow work with wavy hair?
faq.a: Yes. Waves make it look fuller and more natural.

faq.q: What is the difference between a buzz cut and a buzz fade?
faq.a: The top is the same short length, but on a buzz fade the sides fade down to skin.

faq.q: What numbers are used for a buzz fade?
faq.a: Usually #2 on top and #0 at the bottom of the sides, blended through #1.

faq.q: Does a buzz fade need styling?
faq.a: No. Just wash.

faq.q: How often should I re-cut a buzz fade?
faq.a: Every 2–3 weeks to keep the fade clean.

faq.q: Is a high and tight the same as an army cut?
faq.a: It's the classic military version: very short sides cut high, with a short, flat top.

faq.q: Is a high and tight good for sport and the gym?
faq.a: Yes. Very short hair stays cool and needs no styling.

faq.q: What number is used on the sides?
faq.a: Usually #1, cut high up the head.

faq.q: Does a high and tight suit a long face?
faq.a: Not really. High, short sides make a long face look longer.

faq.q: What is a taper fade?
faq.a: A taper with a small fade to skin only at the sideburns and the back of the neck.

faq.q: How is a taper fade different from a low fade?
faq.a: A low fade goes all around the head. A taper fade only touches the sideburns and neck.

faq.q: Is a taper fade OK for strict schools and offices?
faq.a: Usually yes. It's the quietest fade.

faq.q: How often should I re-cut a taper fade?
faq.a: Every 3 weeks.

faq.q: What is a drop fade?
faq.a: A fade whose line curves down behind the ear, following the shape of the head.

faq.q: How is a drop fade different from a low fade?
faq.a: A low fade stays at one height all around. A drop fade dips lower at the back.

faq.q: Does a drop fade work with curly hair?
faq.a: Yes. It suits all hair types.

faq.q: How often does a drop fade need a touch-up?
faq.a: Every 2–3 weeks.

faq.a: Yes. Simple straight or curved lines work best. Ask your barber what they can do.

faq.q: How long do the lines last?
faq.a: About 1–2 weeks before they grow in.

faq.q: Is a line design allowed at school?
faq.a: Many schools don't allow designs. Check your school's rules first.

faq.q: Does cutting the line hurt?
faq.a: No. The trimmer may feel a little scratchy, but it doesn't hurt.

faq.a: Dry, so the barber can see where each curl sits.

faq.a: Curl cream, worked in with your fingers.

faq.a: Don't brush them when dry, and use conditioner 2–3 times a week.

faq.q: Can I get a curly top fade with wavy hair?

faq.a: Usually the side your hair already falls to. The barber can check.

faq.q: Does a side fringe cover a big forehead?
faq.a: Yes. It sweeps across and hides part of the forehead.

faq.q: How do I keep the fringe in place?
faq.a: Blow dry it to the side, then add a little light wax.

faq.q: Is a side fringe good for curly hair?
faq.a: No. Curls won't lie flat across the forehead.

barberSteps: Ask: sweep to left or right?
Blow dry fringe to that side.

name: Wolf Cut
shortLine: Shaggy, layered cut with volume on top and length at the back.
description: Shaggy, layered cut with volume on top and longer hair at the back. Wild and trendy.
pickIf: you want a bold, messy fashion look and have some natural wave.
skipIf: you have a round face or thin hair, or a strict office.
daily: 2 min: a little salt spray or light wax, then ruffle with your fingers.
suitsText: Oval, square, long and heart face · Straight or wavy hair

faq.q: What is the difference between a wolf cut and a mullet?
faq.a: A wolf cut is layered and shaggy all over. A mullet is short at the front and sides, and long only at the back.

faq.q: Does a wolf cut work with straight hair?
faq.a: Yes, but it looks best with some wave. Salt spray adds texture.

faq.q: How long does hair need to be for a wolf cut?
faq.a: At least to the bottom of the ears at the back.

faq.q: Is a wolf cut OK for office?
faq.a: Not in strict offices. It suits college and creative jobs.

barberSteps: Back: keep length, to the collar.
Ends: choppy. Razor or point cut.

name: Man Bun
shortLine: Long hair tied up in a bun at the back of the head.
description: Long hair pulled back and tied in a bun. Relaxed, and it keeps hair off your face.
pickIf: your hair already reaches past your chin and you want to keep it long.
skipIf: your hair is shorter than your chin, or thin.
daily: 2 min: brush back and tie with a soft hair tie.
suitsText: Oval, square, long and heart face · Straight or wavy hair

faq.q: How long does hair need to be for a man bun?
faq.a: Long enough to reach past your chin, so it can be tied back.

faq.q: Can tying my hair every day damage it?
faq.a: Pulling it very tight every day can damage the roots over time. Keep the bun loose and use a soft hair tie.

faq.q: Can I get short sides with a man bun?
faq.a: Yes. Ask for machine #2 on the sides, with the top kept long.

faq.q: How often should I trim a man bun?
faq.a: Every 8 weeks, to remove split ends.

barberSteps: Trim ends only: 1 finger or less.
Ask: short sides too? If yes: machine #2.
Comb back. Tie a bun to check.

name: Head Shave
shortLine: Whole head shaved smooth with a razor.
description: The whole head shaved smooth with a razor. Fresh and bold, and also chosen for rituals.
pickIf: you want the cleanest look, have hair loss, or need it for a ritual.
skipIf: you have a sensitive scalp.
daily: 1 min: moisturiser, and sun cream outdoors.
weekly: Shave at home 2–3 times to stay smooth.
nextVisit: any time, for a smooth barber shave
suitsText: Oval and square face · All hair types · Good for thin hair and hair loss

faq.q: How often do I need to shave my head?
faq.a: Every 2–3 days to keep it smooth.

faq.q: How do I avoid razor bumps on my head?
faq.a: Shave with the hair growth, use a new blade, and moisturise afterwards.

faq.q: Do I need sun cream on a shaved head?
faq.a: Yes, when you're outdoors. A bare scalp burns easily.

faq.q: Can I keep a tupi (small tuft) for a ritual?
faq.a: Yes. Tell the barber before they start.

barberSteps: Ask: keep a small tuft (tupi) at the back?
Ask: sensitive skin or cuts on the scalp?
New blade. Shave with hair growth.

name: Crop Fade
shortLine: Short, rough top pushed forward, with faded sides.
description: A French crop with skin-faded sides: a rough top pushed forward into a short fringe.
pickIf: you want one of the most popular modern cuts with almost no styling.
skipIf: you have a round face.
daily: 1 min: a little dry wax (clay) through the top.
suitsText: Oval, square, long and heart face · All hair types · Thin hair OK

faq.q: What is the difference between a French crop and a crop fade?
faq.a: The top is the same, but on a crop fade the sides go down to skin.

faq.q: Is a crop fade good for thin hair?
faq.a: Yes. The fringe covers the front, and short sides make the top look fuller.

faq.q: What product works best?
faq.a: Dry wax (clay), for a matte, slightly messy look.

faq.q: How often should I re-cut a crop fade?
faq.a: Every 2–3 weeks.

name: Burst Fade
shortLine: Fade that curves around the ear in a half circle.
description: A fade that curves around the ear in a half circle, with a longer back.
pickIf: you want a bold, different fade, often with curls or a mohawk.
skipIf: you have a long face or a strict office.
daily: 3 min: style the top with wax or curl cream.
suitsText: Oval, square, round and heart face · All hair types · Thin hair OK

faq.q: What is a burst fade?
faq.a: A fade that curves around the ear in a half circle, leaving the back longer.

faq.q: Does a burst fade work with curly hair?
faq.a: Yes. It's often paired with curls or a mohawk.

faq.q: Is a burst fade OK for office?
faq.a: Usually not. It's a bold, fashion fade.

faq.q: How often does a burst fade need a touch-up?
faq.a: Every 2 weeks.

barberSteps: Fade shape: half circle around the ear.
Clean the edges around the ear.

name: Mohawk
shortLine: Strip of hair standing up in the middle. Sides very short.
description: A strip of hair standing up from front to back, with very short sides.
pickIf: you want the boldest look in the shop.
skipIf: you have a long face or thin hair, or school or office rules.
daily: 5 min: strong gel or wax, push the strip straight up.
suitsText: Oval, square and round face · All hair types

faq.q: What is the difference between a mohawk and a faux hawk?
faq.a: A mohawk takes the sides very short or bare. A faux hawk keeps them short but not shaved.

faq.q: How wide should the strip be?
faq.a: About 2 fingers, but you can ask for wider.

faq.q: How do I make my mohawk stand up?
faq.a: Blow dry it upward, then use strong gel or wax.

faq.q: Can I wear a mohawk down?
faq.a: Yes. Without product, the strip falls to one side.

barberSteps: Strip width: 2 fingers, front to back.
Blend the strip edges a little.

name: Modern Mullet
shortLine: Short front and sides, longer hair at the back.
description: Short front and sides, with longer hair at the back of the neck. Softer than the old-style mullet.
pickIf: you want a fun fashion look.
skipIf: you have a round face or thin hair, or a strict office.
daily: 2 min: a little light wax, messy on top.
suitsText: Oval, square, long and heart face · Straight or wavy hair

faq.q: What is the difference between a mullet and a wolf cut?
faq.a: A mullet is short at the front and sides and long only at the back. A wolf cut is layered all over.

faq.q: How long does the back need to be?
faq.a: At least 4–5 fingers.

faq.q: Can I get a mullet with a fade?
faq.a: Yes. Many modern mullets have faded sides.

faq.q: Is a mullet OK for office?
faq.a: Not in strict offices.

barberSteps: Neck: clean the edges. Keep the length.

name: Mushroom Cut
shortLine: Rounded fringe all around the head, like a mushroom cap.
description: Korean-style rounded top that falls evenly all around, with a full fringe.
pickIf: you want a soft, neat, young look.
skipIf: you have a round face, curly hair or thin hair.
daily: 3 min: blow dry down and round, a little light spray.
suitsText: Oval, long and heart face · Straight hair

faq.q: Is a mushroom cut the same as a bowl cut?
faq.a: It's a modern, softer version, with soft edges and short sides underneath.

faq.q: Does a mushroom cut work with curly hair?
faq.a: No. It needs straight hair that falls evenly.

faq.q: How do I style a mushroom cut?
faq.a: Blow dry the hair down and slightly round, then add a little light spray.

faq.q: Does a mushroom cut suit a round face?
faq.a: Not really. The rounded shape adds width.

barberSteps: Cut a rounded line all around.

name: Comma Hair
shortLine: Korean fringe curled inward like a comma.
description: Korean fringe parted to one side and curled inward like a comma.
pickIf: you want a popular Korean style and don't mind morning styling.
skipIf: you have a round face, curly hair or thin hair, or no time in the morning.
daily: 5 min: blow dry the fringe inward with a round brush, a little light wax.
suitsText: Oval, square, long and heart face · Straight hair

faq.q: Why is it called comma hair?
faq.a: The fringe curls inward at the end, like a comma.

faq.q: How do I make the comma shape?
faq.a: Blow dry the fringe inward with a round brush, or use a small curling iron.

faq.q: How long should the fringe be?
faq.a: Down to the eyebrows.

faq.q: Can I get comma hair with a perm?
faq.a: Yes. A soft perm on the fringe holds the curl with less daily styling.

barberSteps: Ask: part on left or right?
Fringe: to the eyebrows, longer on one side.
Blow dry fringe inward with a round brush.

name: Korean Perm
shortLine: Soft, loose waves added to the top with a perm.
description: Soft, loose waves added to straight top hair with a perm. Volume without daily styling.
pickIf: your hair is straight and flat and you want easy volume for months.
skipIf: your hair is damaged or already curly, or your scalp is sensitive.
daily: 2 min: a little curl cream, squeeze with your fingers.
weekly: Mild shampoo and conditioner. No hair straightener.
nextVisit: in 4 weeks for a trim. The perm lasts 2–3 months.
suitsText: Oval, square, long and heart face · Straight hair · Thin hair OK

faq.q: How long does a Korean perm last?
faq.a: About 2–3 months.

faq.q: Does a perm damage hair?
faq.a: It can make hair drier. Use mild shampoo and conditioner, and skip the perm if your hair is already damaged.

faq.q: How long does a perm take at the shop?
faq.a: 2–3 hours.

faq.q: When can I wash my hair after a perm?
faq.a: Wait 2 days before using shampoo.

barberSteps: Ask: scalp problems or allergy? If yes, stop.
Cut first: two-block or comma shape.
Roll top hair on medium perm rods.
Apply perm lotion. Wait as on the box.
Rinse. Apply neutraliser. Wait as on the box.
Remove rods. Rinse. No shampoo for 2 days.
barberNote: Best done by someone trained in perms.

name: Brush Up
shortLine: Short sides with the top brushed straight up.
description: Short sides with the top brushed straight up. Fresh, with some height.
pickIf: you want a little height without the work of a quiff.
skipIf: you have a long face.
daily: 2 min: blow dry up, a little wax.
suitsText: Oval, square, round and heart face · Straight or wavy hair · Thin hair OK

faq.q: What is the difference between a brush up and a quiff?
faq.a: A brush up has even height across the top. A quiff has more height at the front.

faq.q: How long should the top be?
faq.a: 2–3 fingers.

faq.q: What product holds a brush up?
faq.a: Wax, after blow drying the top straight up.

faq.q: Is a brush up OK for school and office?
faq.a: Yes. It's neat and not too tall.

barberSteps: Front: same length as the top.

name: Natural Curls
shortLine: Curly hair kept at medium length, shaped evenly all over.
description: Curls kept at medium length, shaped evenly so they look full and tidy.
pickIf: you have curly hair and want to show it off.
skipIf: you have straight hair, a round face or thin hair.
daily: 2 min: curl cream with your fingers. Don't brush when dry.
suitsText: Oval, square, long and heart face · Curly or wavy hair

faq.q: How do I stop my curls from frizzing?
faq.a: Use conditioner, don't brush them when dry, and use curl cream.

faq.q: How often should curly hair be trimmed?
faq.a: Every 6 weeks to keep the shape.

faq.q: Should curly hair be cut wet or dry?
faq.a: Dry, so the barber can see each curl.

faq.q: Can straight hair be made curly?
faq.a: Only with a perm. See H37 Korean Perm.

barberSteps: Cut curls dry, one by one.
Sides: 3 fingers long. Shorter than top.
Shape the outline: round and even.

name: Shoulder Length
shortLine: Long hair worn down, reaching the shoulders.
description: Long hair worn loose to the shoulders, with light layers.
pickIf: you want long hair that looks cared for, not messy.
skipIf: you have a long face or thin hair, or a strict office.
daily: 3 min: brush, a little hair cream on the ends.
suitsText: Oval, square and heart face · Straight or wavy hair

faq.q: How long does it take to grow hair to the shoulders?
faq.a: About 1.5–2 years from a short cut, since hair grows about 1.25 cm a month.

faq.q: Do I need trims while it grows?
faq.a: Yes. Small trims every 8 weeks keep the ends healthy.

faq.q: How do I keep long hair neat?
faq.a: Brush it daily, use conditioner, and put a little hair cream on the ends.

faq.q: Is long hair OK for office?
faq.a: Not in every office. Tying it in a bun can help.

barberSteps: Ask: how much length to keep?

name: School Cut
shortLine: Short, neat cut that meets most school rules.
description: Short and tidy: ears clear, collar clear and the front above the eyebrows.
pickIf: you need a cut that meets school rules.
skipIf: you want a fashion style.
daily: 1 min: comb.
suitsText: All face shapes · All hair types · Thin hair OK

faq.q: What hair rules do schools usually have?
faq.a: Rules differ by school. Many ask for the ears and collar clear and the front above the eyebrows.

faq.q: How short is a school cut?
faq.a: Usually machine #2 on the sides and 1–2 fingers on top.

faq.q: How often does a school cut need a trim?
faq.a: Every 3–4 weeks.

faq.q: Does a school cut need any product?
faq.a: No. Just comb it.

barberSteps: Ask: any school rules for hair?
Front: above the eyebrows. Back: above the collar.

name: Pushed Back
shortLine: Medium top pushed back with a natural, matte finish.
description: Medium top pushed back with a soft, natural finish. Not shiny like a slick back.
pickIf: you want smart but relaxed hair for office and weekends.
skipIf: you have a long face or thin hair.
daily: 3 min: blow dry back, a little matte cream.
suitsText: Oval, square, round and heart face · Straight or wavy hair

faq.q: What is the difference between pushed back and slicked back hair?
faq.a: Pushed back hair has a soft, matte finish. A slick back is shiny and combed flat.

faq.q: What product should I use?
faq.a: Matte cream or matte paste.

faq.q: How long should the top be?
faq.a: About 4 fingers.

faq.q: Does pushed back hair suit a long face?
faq.a: Not really. It shows more forehead, which makes the face look longer.

barberSteps: Sides: machine #3, taper to #2 at neck.
Front: a little longer than back.
